front: Enter a stance cycling arcane power through your body and weapon, boosting melee damage and giving spell resistance.
back:
While in stance: melee Strikes gain arcane trait (magical) and deal 1 extra force damage; resistance 1 to spell damage.
Weapon specialization: 2. Greater weapon specialization: 3.
If you Cast a Spell then enter the stance in the same turn, the stance's damage can be any one damage type that spell could deal instead of force.
